name: Md Tariquzzaman
title: Oracle Infrastructure & Engineered Systems Lead Engineer
tagline: 15+ years designing, implementing and supporting mission-critical Oracle infrastructure for Banking, Telecom and Government.
summary: Oracle Technical Lead and Enterprise Infrastructure Specialist with 15+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure solution design, architecture planning, implementation, migration, high availability, virtualization, troubleshooting and enterprise project delivery.

Deep hands-on expertise across Oracle Exadata Database Machine, Private Cloud Appliance (PCA), Database Appliance (ODA), SPARC and x86 servers, Solaris and Oracle Linux, Solaris Cluster, LDOM and KVM virtualization, ZFS Storage Appliance and StorageTek tape libraries.

Leads technical teams from solution design and planning through installation, configuration, migration, testing, documentation, handover and post-implementation support, translating business requirements into scalable, resilient and secure platforms.
Working knowledge of Dell PowerEdge, Compellent, HPE ProLiant, Cisco UCS and VMware ESXi/vCenter, with growing expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, VMware Cloud Foundation and Red Hat OpenShift.
